s.note: Shifu trains Po by making him fight for the last dumpling
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with 2 cups finely shredded wombok, 1 tbsp grated ginger and 2 chopped spring onions. Fold into 30 dumpling wrappers and steam for 8 minutes. Dip in soy, black vinegar and chilli oil.

s.note: the peach tree where Oogway sits
s.how: Halve 4 ripe peaches and grill cut side down until caramelised. Whip 200g ricotta with a spoon of honey and a pinch of cinnamon. Serve the peaches with the ricotta, more honey and 40g crushed almonds.

m.how: Simmer 1kg chicken frames with ginger, garlic and spring onion in 3L water for 3 hours, then strain. Season with soy and white pepper. Pour over 400g fresh noodles with bok choy and shredded chicken. The secret is there isn't one.

w.how: Beat 125g butter and 120g sugar, then mix in 120g almond meal and 120g flour. Roll into 16 balls, press a whole almond on each and brush with beaten egg. Bake at 170C for 14 minutes until golden.

d.note: the peach tree on the hill where Oogway sits
d.how: Steep 4 jasmine green tea bags in 1 litre water at 80C for 3 minutes, then remove and chill. Blend 2 ripe peeled peaches with 2 tbsp honey and the juice of half a lemon until smooth. Stir the purée into the cold tea. Pour over ice in tall glasses with thin peach slices.
